page.overview:
Who is Gilwen?

Gilwen was a woman of the Edain, and a member of the House of Bëor.

Gilwen was born in the year FA 397 to Bregor. She was the younger sister of Bregil, Hirwen, and Bregolas, and elder sister of Barahir.
